minor.issue: sirix_1_supreme profile.materials has {wood:None, stone:None, iron:None, crystal:None, obsidian:None} — seed-data regression. Caused 500 TypeError '< not supported between NoneType and int' at crafting_router.py:117. Fixed defensively in router (coerce None->0), but seed data still needs to be repopulated so sirix can actually craft.

Rate-limit response uses HTTP 200 with {accepted:false, reason:'rate_limited', retry_in:N} while /api/hybrid-economy/mine quantum_entropy uses HTTP 429. Inconsistent — consider standardizing on 429 for both, or document the difference.

action_items: RESEED sirix_1_supreme user_profiles.materials with real int values (wood/stone/iron/crystal/obsidian) — currently all None, blocking real end-to-end crafting demo. Backend router now defends against None (returns 400 'Missing materials') so no 500s, but UI shows wood:0 stone:0 etc. for the admin which contradicts the handoff note 'sirix has materials seeded'.
OPTIONAL: Standardize rate-limit HTTP status between /mine (429) and /presence/tick (200+accepted:false).
critical_code_review_comments: crafting_router.py original _get_materials returned raw dict from Mongo, exposing it to None values from seed/migration. Hardened to coerce None->0 before comparison.

hybrid_economy_router.py uses in-memory dicts _last_tick / _last_stab for per-user rate limiting. Will not survive worker restarts and will not deduplicate across multiple pods — acceptable for MVP but note for scale-up.
society_router.py CoverRequest.alias has min_length=2 which is correctly enforced (422); good.
Admin-guard pattern: GET /config uses query-param admin_id, PUT /config uses body admin_id. Minor API shape inconsistency but documented via Pydantic model.
